word_reference.scope: Daily automatic action/Agenda budget, truthful deferral, native authority and immutable receipts; not universal automation completion

implemented: AutomaticActionBudget accepts a positive integer required set and serializes account-wide admission under its existing PostgreSQL transaction lock and account-local day. Existing one-action calls and reviewed cadence semantics retained.

Monitoring uses AutomaticPlaybooks, inheriting native selection/conditions/source authorization/idempotence and Flow approval. One private hook enables automatic action/Agenda routing and the new admission check; native manual run! signature and context retained. No parallel write engine.

All newly needed action/activity/meeting keys for the chosen set must fit before creation. Savepoint rolls back new tasks/CRM rows if an automatic Agenda owner is unavailable. Deferred attempts create no PlaybookExecution completion receipt. Existing committed work/history remains intact; native monitoring reevaluates current causes and versions.

Risk steps run idempotently before task admission, including their existing native retention projection. These follow-ups remain deliberately outside the automatic ceiling so critical risks are not suppressed; this is explicit in configuration help. This increment does not claim a universal ceiling across all risk/survey/plan/manual workflows.
Native risk projection now also captures an explicitly configured priority band; regression asserts the actual retained priority80/P1 and preserves the quota exemption.

Account/source-scoped audit stores hashed origin, coded reason, required action count and eligibility time without private playbook contents, global remaining capacity or provider tokens. Repeated same deferral is deduplicated.

Existing customer detail adds a current scoped last-attempt projection; it omits source digest/plan identity. Existing customer UI displays last deferral, reason and eligibility in light/dark themes. No execution guarantee or full pending-inventory claim; existing identity clearing preserved.

Legacy Flow assertions wrongly assumed an empty preserved DB; scoped to their account. Routing intentionally fails fast on configuration contention; concurrency fixture now performs one bounded real retry after transactions finish, still requiring exactly one admitted action.
